nodes.heading: 5.4 Data Acquisition, Integrity, Retention, and Disposal

nodes.name: Master Account (SAKUSEN TOKYO Admin)
nodes.description: Full access across contracted organizations and individual users; manages questionnaire content, AI programs, recommendation logic, and training content.

nodes.name: Sales Account (SAKUSEN TOKYO Sales)
nodes.description: Read-only access to contracted company information.

nodes.name: Company Admin Account (HR)
nodes.description: User issuance, assessment scheduling/invitations/reminders, employee status monitoring, org dashboards, bulk CSV/Excel import.

nodes.name: Partial Admin Account
nodes.description: View and manage only assigned departments or scoped users.

nodes.name: Employee Account
nodes.description: Takes assessments (self and other-rating), views results, participates in LMS training.

nodes.name: Individual Account (B2C)
nodes.description: B2C user with employee-like features plus payment; first quantitative assessment and simple report free.

nodes.title: Complete end-to-end B2B leadership assessment cycle
nodes.description: HR admin issues accounts and invitations; employee completes quantitative assessment, 360 feedback, accepts interim report, qualitative interview (human or AI), receives final integrated report and training recommendations, then completes LMS training.

nodes.title: Company admin manages users and assessment operations
nodes.description: Bulk import/update users, schedule assessments, send invitations and reminders, monitor results and training progress, view organization analytics, delegate via partial admins, handle leaver offboarding.

nodes.title: Employee takes assessment, reviews results, and training
nodes.description: Employee dashboard: assessment taking, result review (history, trends, benchmarks, skill gaps), and LMS training participation with gamification.

nodes.title: Individual (B2C) registers and uses paid assessment path
nodes.description: Individual account creation with free first quantitative assessment; subsequent assessments and interviews paid with human interview priced higher than AI interview.

nodes.title: Service provider configures platform content and logic
nodes.description: Master admin edits questionnaire content, AI programs, recommendation logic, and training catalog; sales has read-only company visibility.

nodes.title: Phase 0 PoC validates AI interview and feedback quality
nodes.description: Prototype AI interview engine, coaching methodology embedding, transcription quality, and 4-level role dialogue before broader frontend development.

nodes.title: Quantitative assessment (64-question questionnaire)
nodes.description: 8 categories × 8 questions, 5-point scale, self and other ratings with 4 role-based patterns (executive, department manager, section manager, general employee).

nodes.title: 360-degree feedback collection
nodes.description: Same 64-question structure for raters; reliability-aware design including Cronbach alpha considerations.

nodes.title: Quantitative assessment engine
nodes.description: Category scoring, self/other/gap computation, radar charts, AI-generated comments, interim report disclosure with 2-week retake restriction after acceptance.

nodes.title: Qualitative assessment (human interview and AI chat)
nodes.description: Human: live session, recording, transcription, AI-assisted feedback. AI: async resumable role-aware coaching chat with history analysis.

nodes.title: Qualitative assessment engine and final integrated report
nodes.description: Merges quantitative and qualitative outputs into final report; 2-week retake restriction after user acceptance completes the cycle.

nodes.title: Assessment result review and benchmarking
nodes.description: Attempt history, trends, internal comparison (hidden if group < 10), external anonymous benchmarking, skill-gap vs target role, training recommendations.

nodes.title: Training LMS with recommendations
nodes.description: HD video streaming, post-video quizzes, progress/gamification (badges/ranks), recommendations linked from assessment gaps; content managed by master account.

nodes.title: Account management and role-based access control
nodes.description: Six account types with hierarchical permissions; leaver deactivation with anonymized statistical archive.

nodes.title: Company admin dashboard and organization analytics
nodes.description: User management, assessment operations, result/training monitoring, analytics by category/role/department, partial admin delegation.

nodes.title: Billing and payment (individual and team plans)
nodes.description: Enterprise, Team, and Individual plans with tiered pricing; Stripe-style payment API for B2C paid assessments and interviews.

nodes.title: External notifications and integration hooks
nodes.description: Slack, Teams, and email notifications via webhooks; SSO-ready architecture for future SAML 2.0.

nodes.title: Support bulk user and organization import via CSV/Excel
Issue assessment invitations and automated reminders
Restrict interim quantitative report retake for 2 weeks after user acceptance
Hide internal anonymous comparison when comparison group has fewer than 10 users
Retain multi-year assessment history per user for trend analysis
Provide first quantitative assessment and simple report free for individual accounts
Encrypt data in transit and at rest
nodes.description: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 or equivalent at rest for sensitive data.

nodes.title: Privacy-law-compliant data handling (Japan APPI, GDPR-ready)
nodes.description: Prefer domestic/Japan-region data hosting; role-based access controls, access logging, and auditing.

nodes.title: Browser and OS compatibility for PC and mobile
nodes.description: Windows 10/11, macOS (latest + 2 prior majors), Chrome/Edge/Safari latest; iOS/Android responsive web or PWA.

nodes.title: Network bandwidth for HD video and AI workloads
nodes.description: Stable connectivity with ~5 Mbps downlink recommended; firewall allowlisting for service domain, video CDN, and GCP AI APIs.

nodes.title: SSO-ready authentication architecture
nodes.description: ID/password initially; SAML 2.0 SSO planned for Phase 3.

nodes.name: User Account
nodes.description: Master, sales, company admin, partial admin, employee, or individual account with role-based permissions.
nodes.title: User Account

nodes.name: Organization
nodes.description: Contracted B2B company with departments, employees, and analytics scope.
nodes.title: Organization

nodes.name: Assessment
nodes.description: End-to-end assessment attempt tying quantitative, 360, qualitative steps, and reports to a user.
nodes.title: Assessment

nodes.name: Questionnaire Response
nodes.description: 64-question self or other-rating responses with category scores.
nodes.title: Questionnaire Response

nodes.name: Assessment Report
nodes.description: Interim quantitative report and final integrated quantitative+qualitative report with acceptance state.
nodes.title: Assessment Report

nodes.name: Interview Record
nodes.description: Human interview recording/transcript or AI chat history used for qualitative feedback.
nodes.title: Interview Record

nodes.name: Training Course
nodes.description: LMS course with video, quiz, completion status, badges, and recommendation linkage.
nodes.title: Training Course

nodes.name: Benchmark Comparison
nodes.description: Internal or external anonymous comparison dataset with anonymity thresholds.
nodes.title: Benchmark Comparison
